Professional Marketer & Advertiser here. It is almost halftime of Superbowl 60, and so far this is the best ad I've seen - by far. Most of the ads this year are very disappointing. I've been critiquing TV ads for 35 years now. This one really works because it does several things well. First, it shows the product early. Many ads fail at this. Second, it moves you. It is Americana, nostalgia, family, and puppies, all proven ingredients. Third, it's an ad you'll remember. You need to succeed with points one and two in order to achieve point number three. If you don't achieve point number three, you will have an ad that may be liked, but won't fulfill its objective - to drive sales or build a brand.
